style: Slow, calm, realistic motion. The camera moves very slowly or stays still. Keep the same scene and composition. No text, no new objects, no faces turning to the camera.

clips.prompt: Students in black puffer jackets slowly walk away down the school hallway, cold morning light
The parent's hands slowly open the worn wallet, warm lamp light flickers softly
Slow sideways dolly along the rack of puffer jackets, shoppers walk past in the background
Hikers in colorful jackets walk steadily up the stone steps, leaves sway in the breeze
Small hikers climb the wooden stairs, clouds drift slowly past the granite peaks
Thin mist drifts slowly between the mountain ridges, clouds move across the dusk sky, very slow push-in
The sea of clouds flows slowly below the summit, sunlight grows warmer, the hiker stands still
String lights twinkle, tent fabric moves gently in the breeze, the river flows in the background
Morning fog drifts slowly across the fairway, the distant golfer walks forward
Shoppers walk slowly through the bright store, slow forward dolly
Red charts on the screens keep falling and flickering, traders move slightly at their desks
Shoppers walk past the mannequins, slow forward dolly along the polished floor
The street lamp flickers, a few pedestrians pass in the distance, very slow push-in along the closed shutters
